## Definition
The integration of sleep EEG criticality metrics into neuromorphic computing pipelines for non-invasive, early-stage dementia prognosis. Bridges clinical neuroscience and TCC by enabling scalable, energy-efficient cognitive decline prediction within network-edge neuromorphic systems.
